files_summary.world.json: Operations domain: slack (4 channels + 80 messages), asana (6 projects + 80 tasks, cross-referenced by project_id/assignee), google_sheets (vendor tracker + project status).
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: asana_list_projects
tool_schemas.description: Returns the Asana projects available to this OpsSync Automation Hub integration connection. It refuses requests when the Asana connection is not configured or cannot be accessed by the current caller, because it cannot list projects without a reachable Asana workspace.

tool_schemas.name: asana_list_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Returns Asana tasks visible to this integration, optionally filtered by project_id, assignee email, and/or completed state. It refuses requests when a provided project_id does not exist or is not accessible to the connected Asana workspace, or when an assignee value is not a valid-looking email for filtering. It may also refuse requests when the Asana connection is missing or lacks permission to read tasks.
tool_schemas.implementation:
_DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0377000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0377000") else "/app/database")
def _load():
    import json
    with open(__import__("os").path.join(_DB, 'world.json'), encoding='utf-8') as f:
        return json.load(f)
def asana_list_tasks(project_id=None, assignee=None, completed=None):
    ts = _load()['asana']['tasks']
    if project_id: ts = [t for t in ts if t.get('project_id') == project_id]
    if assignee: ts = [t for t in ts if t.get('assignee') == assignee]
    if completed is not None: ts = [t for t in ts if t.get('completed') == completed]
    return ts

tool_schemas.name: asana_get_task
tool_schemas.description: Returns the Asana task that matches the provided task id. It refuses requests with a missing or empty id, or when the id does not resolve to a task the integration can access. It may also refuse requests when the Asana connection is not configured or does not have permission to read the task.

tool_schemas.name: asana_create_task
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Asana task with the provided name and project_id, and returns the created task. It refuses requests with missing required fields, a blank name, an invalid due_on format (must be YYYY-MM-DD), or a project_id that does not exist or is not writable by the connected workspace. It also refuses requests when an assignee is provided but cannot be validated as an email or is not assignable in the target project/workspace.

tool_schemas.name: asana_complete_task
tool_schemas.description: Marks the specified Asana task as completed and returns the updated task. It refuses requests with a missing or empty id, when the task cannot be found or accessed by this integration, or when the task is already completed or otherwise not in a state that can be updated. It may also refuse the request if the Asana connection lacks permission to modify the task.

tool_schemas.name: google_sheets_list_spreadsheets
tool_schemas.description: Returns the Google Sheets spreadsheets available to this OpsSync Automation Hub connection. It refuses requests when the Google connection is not configured, expired, or lacks permission to list files, because it cannot enumerate spreadsheets without access.

tool_schemas.name: google_sheets_get_values
tool_schemas.description: Returns all values from the first worksheet of the specified spreadsheet as a list of rows (each row is a list of cell values). It refuses requests with a missing or empty spreadsheet identifier, or when the provided name/id does not resolve to an accessible spreadsheet. It also refuses requests when the integration lacks permission to read the spreadsheet.

tool_schemas.name: google_sheets_append_row
tool_schemas.description: Appends a new row to the first worksheet of the specified spreadsheet and returns the appended row (or the updated sheet state, depending on integration settings). It refuses requests with a missing spreadsheet identifier, a missing row, or a row that is not an array of strings. It also refuses requests when the spreadsheet cannot be found, is not writable, or the connection lacks permission to modify it.

row.description: Cell values for the new row.

tool_schemas.name: slack_list_channels
tool_schemas.description: Returns the Slack channels visible to this OpsSync Automation Hub integration in the connected workspace. It refuses requests when the Slack connection is not configured or lacks the scope/permission required to list channels, because it cannot read the workspace channel directory.

tool_schemas.name: slack_find_channel
tool_schemas.description: Looks up a Slack channel by its name (without the leading #) and returns the matching channel if found. It refuses requests with a missing or blank name, or with a name that contains invalid channel-name characters for the workspace. It also refuses requests when the Slack connection is missing or lacks permission to search/list channels, or when the named channel is not visible to the integration.

tool_schemas.name: slack_get_channel_messages
tool_schemas.description: Lists the messages currently recorded for the Slack channel identified by channel_id and returns them in chronological order. It refuses requests that omit channel_id or provide a blank/unknown channel_id, because the channel cannot be located. It also refuses requests for channels you don’t have access to in this service’s Slack connection.

tool_schemas.name: slack_send_channel_message
tool_schemas.description: Posts a new message with the provided text into the Slack channel identified by channel_id and returns the created message record. It refuses requests missing channel_id or text, with blank text, or with an unknown channel_id because it can’t determine where to post. It also refuses posting to channels you don’t have access to or to channels that are not writable under the current Slack connection.

metadata.name: OpsSync Automation Hub
metadata.description: A lightweight integration service that unifies Slack, Asana, and Google Sheets data and actions into a single API for building and running operational automation workflows.
